select dri.refund_code as refundId, dri.platform_order_id, dri.platform_name, dri.shop_name, drid.sku_no, drid.refund_num, dri.refund_amount, round(dri.refund_amount * dri.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, round(dri.refund_amount * dri.cny_settle_rate,2) as cny_settle_amount, dri.refund_status, dri.refund_time, dri.order_time from dmp_refund_info dri inner join dmp_refund_item drid on dri.id = drid.refund_id
and dri.refund_code like concat('%',#{params.refundId},'%')
and dri.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and dri.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and dri.platform_name like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and dri.refund_status = #{params.refundStatus}
and dri.refund_time >= #{params.refundTime_begin}::timestamp
and dri.refund_time <= #{params.refundTime_end}::timestamp
and dri.order_time >= #{params.orderTime_begin}::timestamp
and dri.order_time <= #{params.orderTime_end}::timestamp
